extracted.intended_audience: emerging feature filmmakers (screenwriters and first-time fiction directors) seeking Sundance Institute Feature Film Program labs, intensives, fellowships, and grants
extracted.subtask_description: Information and selection/eligibility criteria for the Sundance Institute Feature Film Program (Screenwriters Lab, Directors Lab, Intensives, fellowships, and grants), aimed at supporting emerging filmmakers with work-in-progress fiction feature screenplays and first-time fiction feature directors. Covers program values, eligibility windows, types of support, and high-level selection considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinctive, audience-engaging films
rubrics_metrics.description: The Feature Film Program 'has championed leading independent filmmakers of the past 40 years whose distinctive films have engaged audiences worldwide.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program favors projects/filmmakers whose work is distinctive and demonstrably engages audiences (examples of alumni projects and festival awards are shown as exemplars).

rubrics_metrics.name: Embrace each artist’s unique vision / individual perspective
rubrics_metrics.description: The program 'embraces each artist’s unique vision' and encourages telling a story 'from a very individual perspective, instead of trying to please everybody while you tell your story.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection and lab practice prioritize authenticity of voice and personal point-of-view; quote from Marielle Heller highlights that the Lab builds confidence to tell singular stories rather than generic ones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rigorous, in-depth creative process
rubrics_metrics.description: The program 'encourages a rigorous, in-depth creative process' and provides an atmosphere where experimentation and risk-taking are encouraged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should demonstrate commitment to a deep creative process and willingness to experiment; labs/intensives are structured to support sustained, rigorous development rather than cursory feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original and deeply resonant storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: The Feature Film Program focuses on 'original and deeply resonant storytelling.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories that offer originality and emotional or cultural resonance are aligned with the program's mission; past selected projects and award-winning alumni exemplify these qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core values: risk-taking, community, and freedom of expression
rubrics_metrics.description: The Institute’s guiding values are 'risk-taking, community, and freedom of expression' which have broadened the program's reach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and projects should align with or embody these values; programming and mentorship promote creative risk and a supportive community environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: American and international artists; cross-cultural engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: The FFP includes 'American and international artists in a more meaningful and vibrant dialogue across cultural, political, and geographic boundaries.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: International and cross-cultural perspectives are prioritized; the program supports cultural and artistic exchange and partners with organizations to reach regional filmmaking communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development Track eligibility: emerging artist with work-in-progress fiction feature screenplay
rubrics_metrics.description: The Development Track application is open to 'emerging artists with a work-in-progress fiction feature screenplay' to be considered for the Screenwriters Lab or Intensive, as well as fellowships and grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must have a WIP fiction feature screenplay and be positioned as emerging artists; this is the explicit eligibility requirement for the Development Track.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directors Lab eligibility: first-time fiction feature directors
rubrics_metrics.description: The Directors Lab gives 'eight first-time fiction feature directors the chance to workshop scenes under the guidance of experienced creative advisors.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directors Lab is targeted at filmmakers making their first fiction feature; selection is limited (eight slots) and geared toward hands-on scene workshopping and development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lab atmosphere: experimentation and risk-taking encouraged
rubrics_metrics.description: The Screenwriters Lab, Directors Lab, and Screenwriters Intensive create 'an atmosphere where experimentation and risk-taking is encouraged.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The labs actively foster creative experimentation; applicants should be open to unconventional approaches and iterative development during residencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: By-invitation participation for certain labs
rubrics_metrics.description: Some offerings (notably the June Directors and Screenwriters Lab) are marked '*By invitation only*'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all program opportunities are open via the general application; certain sessions or components require an invitation rather than an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing alumni support across development, production, post-production, and distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: After participation in one of the Labs, FFP Fellows 'will continue to receive a robust suite of customized creative and tactical assistance as they move forward from development through distribution.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support includes attaching producers, identifying potential financiers, mentors, key crew and producer recommendations, and programs like Works-In-Progress Screening Initiative; projects at multiple stages may receive targeted assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowships and grants awarded based on impact, timing, urgency, and quality of work
rubrics_metrics.description: FFP staff 'work together with these partners to award funds, as they consider impact, timing, urgency, and quality of work as key criteria.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When awarding fellowships/grants, the program evaluates projects for their potential impact, the timing/need for funds, urgency of support, and the intrinsic quality of the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regionally tailored partnership programs and year-round online access
rubrics_metrics.description: In partnership with the Collab learning platform and other organizations, the Feature Film Program 'is also working with partner organizations to provide year-round access to the Sundance community with online experiences that are tailored to the specific needs and challenges for international film communities.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic offerings may be adapted to regional contexts; international applicants can expect region-specific online resources and partnerships addressing local challenges.
